# `utils/TextureCompression.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/TextureCompression.js`

TextureCompression - WebGPU compressed texture format support. Supports: - BC formats (Desktop: DXT/S3TC) - ASTC formats (Mobile/Apple) - ETC2 formats (Android/WebGL fallback)

## Functions

### `detectCompressedFormats(adapter)`

Detect supported compressed texture formats.

**Parameters:**

- `adapter` *(GPUAdapter)* — WebGPU adapter

**Returns:** Supported format info

### `getOptimalFormat(adapter, needsAlpha = true)`

Get optimal texture format for device.

**Parameters:**

- `adapter` *(GPUAdapter)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `needsAlpha` *(boolean)* — Whether alpha channel is needed

**Returns:** GPUTextureFormat

### `getCompressedSize(width, height, format)`

Calculate compressed texture size.

**Parameters:**

- `width` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `height` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `format` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._

**Returns:** Size in bytes

### `getMemorySavings(width, height, compressedFormat)`

Calculate memory savings percentage.

### `getQualitySizeScore(width, height, format, options = {})`

Calculate a quality-size report for picker and audit UI.

### `createCompressedTexture(device, adapter, descriptor)`

Create compressed texture with fallback.

**Parameters:**

- `device` *(GPUDevice)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `adapter` *(GPUAdapter)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `descriptor` *(Object)* — Texture descriptor

### `getFormatInfo(format)`

Get format info for display.

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
